english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for surrounding something, including figurative cases and situations where escape is blocked.
Use 包圍 specifically when engulf means surrounding something without necessarily covering or submerging it.
Use this when something physically surrounds or encircles something else.

examples.english: The police surround the suspect, leaving them nowhere to go.
examples.traditional: 警察包圍咗疑犯，佢冇路走。
examples.jyutping: ging2 caat3 baau1 wai4 zo2 ji4 faan6 keoi5 mou5 lou6 zau2

examples.english: A large group of reporters began to engulf the singer, leaving him unable to move.
examples.traditional: 一大班記者喺門口包圍住個歌手，搞到佢行唔到。
examples.jyutping: jat1 daai6 baan1 gei3 ze2 hai2 mun4 hau2 baau1 wai4 zyu6 go3 go1 sau2 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 haang4 m4 dou3

examples.english: Tall buildings on all sides encompass the park.
